about: EmpireCraft files ported from the WorldBox mod, written by Tools/PortTool/port_tool.py. One entry per ported file: mod path ("path#Type" when only single declarations were lifted out of a larger file), the mod commit it was copied from, the port date, the destination, what the tool changed and what was changed by hand (notes). kind is source, extract or data. Code written new for this repository (entities, world operations, host layer, RealmAccounts) has no entries.
